answer: Make every agent lock a small refundable stake tied to one verified device key before it can trade. Faking a thousand identities then means funding a thousand stakes, so the attacker's cost climbs like waves hitting a ledge: each new fake burns another ember of capital for no return. Reputation accrues only to staked identities that finish real work, so honest agents keep both stake and standing, while cheap copies drown in an ocean of verification costs and can never outvote the network.
